review: A good welfare ID. She has okay damage output and clashing power of 13/16/16. She shines in a Blade Lineage team consisting of Blade Lineage Meursault and at least 1 more Blade Lineage ID. Her main use is giving poise to other Blade Lineage IDs with the least poise making them more consistent in critting and maintaining it. With said team she essentially makes the rest of them ramps poise much faster to the point of being able to maintain poise outside of MD and making them viable when paired with Blade Lineage Meursault. Notable E.G.O. Synergies Wishing Cairn - Can help with Poise ramp-up, especially in mob battles
